profileEvidence.summary: Persistent scent work and ringing pack voices marked the historical Rough Beagle. These rough-coated hounds shared the Beagle’s patient pursuit of a hare’s line. Larger rough Beagles once worked in Welsh and Essex country, while Gorham’s smaller Telscombe pack appeared at Reigate in the early twentieth century.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Historical rough-coated Beagles followed scent with persistence and lively pack voices; Gorham kept a smaller Telscombe pack.
